metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by willard-pro — ticket automation pipelines and development tooling

plugins.name: ticket-planner
plugins.description: 10-phase autonomous planner — turns business ideas into dependency-ordered planned tickets. Appraisal → Discovery → Architecture → Specify → Review → Consensus → Crosscheck → Epic Gen → Ticket Gen → Completed. Produces Planner Context blocks, Branch Directives for shared epic branches, and initiative epics with planned tickets ready for fleet-controller dispatch. Supports grill-me validated intent files as optional pre-flight gate.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Pre-work readiness gate — assesses business ideas against profile-driven dimensions, asks ranked clarification questions interactively, scores readiness deterministically, and produces cryptographically sealed Validated Business Intent documents. Any agent can invoke it before acting.

plugins.name: ticket-auto-pipeline
plugins.description: Fully autonomous Linear ticket pipeline — appraise, implement, verify, and merge with zero user input. Bundles 20+ skills, state machine config, pipeline safety gates, and retrospective analysis.

plugins.name: knowledge-curator
plugins.description: Durable cross-project knowledge tracking — capture ideas, decisions, lessons, and discoveries with low friction, automatic resurfacing, and a dispatchable work stack.

plugins.name: fleet-controller
plugins.description: Parent orchestrator above ticket-planner and ticket-auto — dispatches planned tickets from initiative epics, monitors all active pipeline health via 12 detection engines, manages epic branch lifecycle (create, sync, GC), and aggregates execution feedback back to the planner. Bash-only, zero Claude agents.
